name: Joshah
overview: Joshah was a male member of the tribe of Simeon, identified specifically as the son of Amaziah. His mention in Scripture is brief, primarily noting his tribal affiliation and lineage within the Simeonite family. There are no additional notes or details about his life or activities.
namesAndTitles: The name Joshah means "gift of YHWH," reflecting a theologically significant meaning common in Hebrew names, though it was not indicated that this name was given directly by God. This proper name appears in 1 Chronicles 4:34.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Joshah as the son of Amaziah, establishing a clear paternal relationship. Beyond this, no further family connections are noted in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Joshah's significance lies in his identification as a Simeonite and as a descendant of Amaziah, contributing to the genealogical records that preserve the heritage of the tribe of Simeon. His mention in 1 Chronicles 4:34 situates him within the broader biblical narrative of Israel's tribal families, underscoring the importance of lineage in God's covenant people.
